headline: Thinnest weekend of the last twelve, though Sunday itself earned its keep
commentary:
### The weekend
- The weekend cleared **$1,436**, the lowest of the last twelve.
  - Weekend NP: $1,436 v $3,237 prior weekend
  - Four-weekend average: $6,825
- Spend came off a third and the leads came off with it.
  - Cost: $36,488 v $58,441 prior weekend
  - Sold: 2,698 v 3,357
- Margin ran thin because lead value was soft on both days.
  - Weekend NM%: 3.79% v 13.47% average
  - Weekend EPL: $14.02 v $17.05 average
### Friday
- Friday did $5,446, down on the week before but a normal day.
  - NP: $5,446 v $7,851 on 23/10
  - Search EPL: $22.44 v $28.38
- Sunday on its own was the better half, above the eight-Sunday average.
  - Sunday NP: $2,735 v $2,068 mean
  - Sunday EPL: $15.91 v $15.55 mean
- Saturday was the hole, as flagged in Saturday's note.
  - Saturday NP: −$1,299 v $721 last Sat
  - Saturday cost: $21,870
### What drove it
- Sunday was a **volume story, not a lead-value one**.
  - Search clicks: 1,394 v 1,823 last Sun
  - Search EPL: $23.46 v $24.23 last Sun
- Clicks got cheaper as holiday-weekend demand thinned out the auction.
  - Search CPC: $10.13 v $11.29
  - Impressions: 13,137 v 17,188
- Rivals leaned in on the big terms while our share slipped.
  - amount IS: 18.9% v 23.1% last Sun
  - fastloanadvance account IS: +5.7pts week on week
- Evenings carried the money; late afternoon paid badly.
  - 23:00 EPL: $45.83 on 89 clicks
  - 17:00 EPL: $10.78 on 109 clicks
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 01/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SAs off, ROAS targets | competitor + personal | $454 | $562 | — |
| Speed walk-down | high target, stepping down | $501 | $539 | — |
| Scavenger pair | cheap clicks, tROAS/tCPA | $624 | $1,027 | — |
- The scavengers are scheduled off at weekends, yet they still spent.
  - Scavenger spend: $624 v $1,027 last Sun
- Speed stays small by design while the target is high.
  - speed clicks: 29 v 30 last Sun
watch: Search EPL over the next few days — the weekend ran $20.74 against a $27.80 four-weekend average, and we want to see that gap close as the holiday traffic clears.
Impression share on amount and payday_alternative, both down about four points week on week while super.com and fastloanadvance add share.
Whether CPC holds near $10.13 once normal weekday demand comes back, or drifts back towards the $11-12 we were paying.
